title: SAP-C03: four tests to run on the option you like

questions.ask: Does it leave unchanged the number that failed (downtime, data lost, a percentile, a cost)?
Does the stem say prevent or must never, while the option only reports?
Does it buy a commitment or a fixed fleet for variable use?
Does the service lack the one property the scenario insists on?
questions.yes: Family 4: name fits, mechanism does not. Reject

otherwise: The option survives all four tests: choose it
